title: Describe the problem so someone else can help
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Describe the observation — Name the specific gap and the evidence for its scope.; State the desired condition — Explain what should happen and why it matters.; Separate possible causes — Keep hypotheses and preferred solutions visible as such.; Check the framing — Ask affected people to correct facts and boundaries..

steps.label: Describe the observation
steps.detail: Name the specific gap and the evidence for its scope.

steps.label: State the desired condition
steps.detail: Explain what should happen and why it matters.

steps.label: Separate possible causes
steps.detail: Keep hypotheses and preferred solutions visible as such.

steps.label: Check the framing
steps.detail: Ask affected people to correct facts and boundaries.
